propositions: verify.overlap_enabled lacks documentation in docs/config.md and its name obscures that it controls LLM-backed duplicate ticket suggestions rather than a verification gate
The canonical config key must be renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to clarify the feature's advisory output and prevent confusion with blocking gates
Both the old TOML key and old env var must remain functional as permanent aliases (not deprecations) via _ALIASES and _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES without breaking existing project configs or live deployments
All in-source readers (enrich_drain.py, plan_review/__init__.py) and the repo's own rebar.toml must use the new canonical name; all old-name occurrences outside back-compat sites must be eliminated
The new key and both alias paths must be registered in the deprecation registry with permanent=True, and their messages must state 'permanent alias' rather than 'scheduled for removal'
